text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis. The history of maternal gonorrhea, the 4-day age of the infant, and the presence of pustules with an erythematous base on the trunk and extremities (sparing palms and soles) are classic findings for disseminated neonatal gonococcal infection.
